date_note: The article says the incident occurred on the afternoon of Sunday 22 November.
title: Cyberattack blocks IT system of Northern Tyrrhenian Sea Port Authority (Livorno)
org: Autorità di sistema portuale del Mar Tirreno Settentrionale
geo_basis: the authority's offices at Palazzo Rosciano, Livorno, named in the article
summary: Toscana Media News, citing the port authority's statement, reports a cyberattack on the Northern Tyrrhenian Sea Port Authority on the afternoon of Sunday 22 November that blocked its IT system. PCs at Palazzo Rosciano and other offices were disconnected from the network, as was the GTS3 system temporarily. The authority has not yet established the nature of the intrusion; checks continue.
plain: The port authority for Livorno, Piombino and other ports says an attack blocked its IT system. It disconnected computers as a precaution; it is still checking what happened.
exec: A port authority's IT system was blocked and the GTS3 system was temporarily disconnected, per the authority's statement as reported; checks continue.

validation.note: One publisher (Toscana Media News) relaying the authority's statement; the authority's own page and a second publisher were not found.
